Hi Sean,

We completed an internal audit and saw Aurora Labs exceeded its committed capacity for Aug–Sep 2026 by ~1.2M inference-minutes. Can you please provide: a line-item reconciliation, the one-time top-up invoice you propose, and any guidance on how this would be handled if we move forward with the renewal/expansion we discussed last quarter?

I've attached our exported usage (aurora_usage_export_May-Sep.csv) — the raw numbers are in the 3rd tab. Our billing team asked that the invoice be split into two line items (usage top-up + contract amendment fee) and that payment terms be net30.

Hi Elena — thanks for the export. We pulled the file into our reconciliation template and have a suggested settlement path below. Looping in Ben (finance) and Laura (CS) to confirm pricing/credits.

Proposal (preliminary):
- Calculate overage at committed unit rate (per-inference-minute) for the 1.2M overage = $54,600
- One-time contract amendment fee (administration + pro-rated SLA) = $2,250
- Goodwill consideration: if Aurora signs the renewal amendment to increase committed capacity by >=25% within 30 days, Redwood will apply a 30% credit to the one-time amendment fee (i.e., $675).
- Final invoice split as requested (line1: usage top-up $54,600; line2: amendment fee $2,250 minus any eligible credit).

Next steps I need from you: confirm PO (or billing contact), desired invoice split, and whether Aurora plans to execute the renewal amendment within 30 days so Ben can provision the conditional credit. I've attached a working sheet (redwood_proposed_settlement_v1.xlsx) with our calculations.

If that approach looks good, we'll generate two invoice PDFs and a DocuSign amendment for signature.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sean / Laura — I pulled Elena's CSV and applied the committed rates from their current SOW. Quick summary of calculations (high level):
- Measured overage: 1,198,600 inference-minutes (rounded)
- Committed unit rate used: $0.045/min
- Usage top-up: $53,937.00 (pre-tax)
- Admin/amendment fee: $2,250.00
- Subtotal: $56,187.00

Recommendation: because Aurora is already in active talks to expand, suggest we offer a one-time goodwill credit of 50% on the admin/amendment fee (i.e., $1,125) rather than the 30% in the AE note. That will keep the commercial thread moving and is <1% of deal ACV. If approved by sales leadership, we can present the final net amendment fee as $1,125 and invoice per Elena's requested split.

Also note: if they ask to amortize the usage top-up over the next 2 invoices, we can do a billing split but need the PO to reconcile with accounting.

Ben
